description: Complete Minor Road Works is a dataset listed in Ballarat open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ballarat. Coverage: Ballarat, Victoria. The portal shows 1,087 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ballarat-vic-gov-au-portal.
